message.content: [罪名]生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: Defendant Fang from July 2012 to Feb 13 2013 sold large amounts of expired lamb meat in two hotpot restaurants, sales amount 260k RMB. Then on Feb 14 2013 discovered meat over expiration but continued selling until May 10 when food supervision caught. From Feb 14 onward sales amount 36k RMB, seized expired meat value 220k RMB.

Thus crimes: selling expired food, which under Chinese criminal law is "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪" (selling unsafe food). The specific article: "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪" (刑法第二百三十七条). Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But selling expired food is covered by "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪". Also could be "侵犯消费者权益罪"? Not typical. The main crime is "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪". Also maybe "非法经营罪" if no license? Not indicated.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪<eoa>
